rv.q: This show is perfect for those who enjoy musical comedies full of spectacle.

The full orchestra under Eugene Dizon’s musical direction and the boffo choreography by Darryl K. Clark add the old-fashioned razzmatazz this slyly self-conscious (and still subversive) throwback to the golden age of Broadway deserves.
THE PRODUCERS is a whole lot of fun…especially Act 2!
Eugene Dizon’s Musical Direction and his Conducting of that glorious orchestra is, without doubt, the best reasons to enjoy this show.
This is absurdity and farce at its best.
Their 150th production is Mel Brooks zany comedy, "The Producers" and what a wonderful evening of theater it is!
And, anyone who likes the flavor of Brooks’ comedy style, as I do, will love The Producers at Music Theater Works.
The Producers is a fun break in the theater season.

cn.t: Critics praise this wildly funny production of Mel Brooks' outrageous musical, with strong performances and choreography making full use of the larger venue. The offensive humor still shocks and entertains in equal measure.
